statement: Retiring a delivered lesson seed means deleting it, not moving it into a subfolder of the holding directory: the delivery guard scans subdirectories, so a moved seed is still counted as undelivered. Occurrence 2026-10-01, cejel #382 and #383: both renamed five seeds already delivered to alfred into maeve-unanchored-lessons/delivered/, and build-test failed with maeve_lesson_directory_undelivered fileCount=5. That one red check, together with main's stale copies, blocked four unrelated PRs (#378 to #381). Fixed in #383 by deleting the files, after confirming all five had identical blob SHAs on alfred main. Rule: complete a delivery by removing the file and verifying the destination copy byte for byte; a new subfolder inside a guarded directory never takes a file out of the guard's scope.
